annotations.title: Prepare a FirmLedger listing submission link

description: Does NOT create anything. Returns a link to the real FirmLedger submission form with the company name, website and (optional) category, country and city pre-filled. The user opens it, signs in, completes the remaining fields, reviews everything and submits it themselves. Also reports if the company is already listed, so nothing is submitted twice.
name: prepare_listing_submission
title: Prepare a FirmLedger listing submission link
